evidence.reason: Fixed apps/crq-python/review_history.py so the fallback delta builder retains the headline's commits_ahead (instead of forcing None) when the tree delta is absent, keeping the response consistent with predecessor.commits_ahead and letting the cue report the known commit distance; tests were not run since the harness exposes only git/read/edit tools, correctness verified by inspecting the owned diff against all branch cases and the review-operation delta schema.
